headline: DA Finance Chief Steps Back Amid R4bn Crypto Probe
script: Big shake-up in Parliament's money committees. DA finance spokesperson Mark Burke has been pulled off Parliament's finance oversight committees after his fintech company, Kastelo, got hit with a Reserve Bank investigation into alleged exchange-control violations worth about R4 billion. Kastelo ran a crypto arbitrage scheme, and the Reserve Bank alleges some clients earning R15,000 a month were given loans of about R249,000 to exploit their offshore allowances, without fully understanding what was happening. A Johannesburg court already sided with the Reserve Bank, refusing to unfreeze Kastelo's accounts. Burke says he's done nothing wrong and stepped back voluntarily. Why it matters: this is about protecting South Africa's foreign currency reserves and making sure ordinary people's money isn't quietly used in schemes they don't understand, exactly the financial literacy gap young South Africans navigating crypto and side hustles need to watch.
why_it_matters: It's a real-time lesson in crypto risk and financial rules that could catch out young South Africans dabbling in offshore trading or side-hustle fintech schemes.
